entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. CCXLII. , S. 314, CCXLII.
entries.german:
1462. 30. December. Krumau. — Johann von Rosenberg übergibt dem Stifle Hohenfurt die von seinem Vater Ulrich in Österreich versetzten Stiftskleinodien und heiligen Reliquien.

CCXLII. My Jan z Rozmberka y s swymi diediczi a buduczymi wyzna- wame tiemto listem obecznie przed kazdym czlowiekem, ktoz geig vzrzie a czisti neb cztucze slysseti budu, jakoz niekdy vrozeny pan pan Oldrzich z Rozmberga otecz nass mily w czasy nebezpeczne a wiilecznie pro obr;mu wiery krzestianske, take y pro zachowanie panstwie nasseho zastawil byl klenoty niektere a swatosti tak zasta- wene bez gednoho cztyrzidczeti leth w Rakusiech z zemie chowany gsu byli. A my rozpomenuwsse sie na pana boba y take hlediecze ezti y rozssirzenie panstwije nasseho a zwlasstie tiech bozijch domuow, od kterychz ta swatost a klenoti odgiati byli, chtiecze, aby k chwale bozij a geho matky panny Marie y wssech swatych sluzba bozie radiegij se na panstwij nassem rozmnozowala, nezli menssena byla, ty giste klenoty a swatosti s praczij nassij a naklady nemalymi diel y panstwie nasseho proto zastawiwsse wyplatili sme, a w nassi mocz prziwedli, z kterychzto klenotuow o tyto kusy a klenoty y sva- tosti dolepsane zlattee a strziebrne y pozlaczene smluwu rzadnu s cztihodnym v boze otczem knizem Pawlem opatem klasstera Wysse- brodskeho a conuentem tehoz klasslera otto vcziniwsse wedle milosti za to penieze wzelisme, a temuz klassteru nassemu Wyssebrodskemu ty klenoty a swatosti zasie dali sme a nawratili. Item genz wazie tocziz naiprwe krzijz weliky zlatly wsseczken dewiet hrziwen. Item druhy krzijz maly take zlaty wsseczken dwie hrziwnie a gedenaczt lottuow. Item kalich wsseczken zlatty sedm hrziwen bez lottu. Item tabula swate Marzie Magdaleny dwanadczt hrziwen a osm lottuow 301 Item tabula s ruozemi deivatenadczt hrziwen. Item kalich s ruoczemi cztyrzy hrziwny a dwanadozt lottuow. Item monslrancia dwanadczt hrziwen a dwanadczt lottuow. Item kalich przeworuow dwie hrziwnie a sedm lottuow. Item kalich przeworuow dwie hrziwnie a sedm lot tuow. Hem kalich brafra Thuomy gednu hrziwn>i a cztrnadczt lottuow. Item a kalich opatuuw trzy hrziwni a frzy lotly. Slibugicze cztnie wiernie u prawie za se y za sue dierlicze a buduezie panu bohu u geho nsyslawnieyssij matcze pannie Marigi y wssem swatym tiech swrchupsanych klenotuow a swatosti nikdy wiecznie od tehoz klass- tera neodluczowati, any brati zadnym obyczegem, ani kteru mieru. Paklibychom my kdy, nebo kto nassish diediczuow nebo buduczich proti tomu, czoz se swrchupisse, czo vczinili a nezdrzeli, ten nebti aby se wiediel neb wiedieli w nemilost bozij panny Marie matky geho y wssech swatych wpadnuti, a zprziekaz tiech wieczij w den sudny poczet z toho dluzen bude aneb budu dati. Toho na zdrzenie a zachowanie peczet nassi wlastnij k tomuto listu dali sme a kazali prziwiesyti dobrowolnie. Genz gest dan a psan na Crumlowie leta od narozeni sina bozieho tisiczieho czyrzsteho ssede- sateho druheho ten cztwrtek przed nowym letem. Ein ziemlich grosses, an einem Pergamentstreifen hängendes Siegel in rothem Wachs. — Ein Schild mit einer Rose, darüber Helm wieder mit einec Hose. — Sigillum . Johanis . De . Rosenberg.
entries.english:
1462, 30 December. Krumau. — Hans von Rosenberg transfers to Hohenfurt Monastery the monastery treasures and holy relics that his father Ulrich had pawned in Austria.

CCXLII. I, Hans von Rosenberg, together with my heirs and successors, hereby declare publicly before everyone who sees and reads this letter, or hears it read, that once the noble lord Oldrzich of Rosenberg, our beloved father, in dangerous and warlike times, for the defense of the Christian faith and the preservation of our dominion, had pawned certain treasures and holy objects. These pledges had remained in Austria, out of our land, for nearly forty years. Remembering God and seeking the honor and enlargement of our dominion, especially of those houses of God from which the holy objects and treasures had been taken, and wishing that divine service might be increased rather than diminished in our dominion, to the glory of God, his mother the Virgin Mary, and all the saints, we redeemed those same treasures and holy objects through our efforts and at considerable expense, partly pledging our own dominion for them, and brought them into our possession. Of these treasures we made a proper agreement with the venerable father in God, Lord Paul, abbot of Vyšší Brod Monastery, and its convent; with their gracious consent, we received the money for them and gave and returned these treasures and holy objects to that same monastery of ours at Vyšší Brod. The following gold and silver, gilded treasures and holy objects are included: one large gold cross, weighing nine grivnas; one small gold cross, weighing two grivnas and eleven lots; one gold chalice, weighing seven grivnas less one lot; a panel of Saint Mary Magdalene, weighing twelve grivnas and eight lots; a panel with roses, weighing nineteen grivnas; a chalice with roses, weighing four grivnas and twelve lots; a monstrance, weighing twelve grivnas and twelve lots; a chalice with [unclear word], weighing two grivnas and seven lots; another chalice with [unclear word], weighing two grivnas and seven lots; a chalice of Master Thom, weighing one grivna and fourteen lots; and an abbot’s chalice, weighing three grivnas and three lots. We faithfully and truly promise for ourselves, our heirs, and successors that these treasures and holy objects named above shall never be separated from the monastery, taken away, or otherwise removed, by any means or measure. If we or any of our heirs or successors should act against this declaration and fail to keep it, then he or they shall know that they have incurred the displeasure of God, the Virgin Mary his mother, and all the saints, and on Judgment Day shall be liable to answer for the loss of these things. As security for the observance and keeping of this promise, we have willingly given and ordered our own seal to be attached to this letter. Given and written at Krumau in the year 1462 after the birth of God’s Son, on the Thursday before New Year’s Day.

A rather large seal in red wax, attached to a parchment strip. A shield with a rose; above it, a helmet, again with a rose. — “Sigillum . Johanis . De . Rosenberg.”
